paper_title: Gas-rich dwarf galaxies as a new probe of dark matter interactions with ordinary matter
notes: This paper uses observations of dwarf galaxies (Leo T and Milky Way gas clouds) to constrain generic dark matter interactions (ultra-light hidden photons, millicharged DM, DM-nucleon scattering) through indirect constraints on heating/cooling rates. It does not report measurements of the canonical AxionLimitBench coupling types (AxionPhoton, AxionElectron, AxionNeutron, etc.). The paper is a reinterpretation of existing observations rather than a direct new measurement of axion or dark photon couplings.
